title: Lantern diff output
description: Machine-readable comparison of two Beacon evidence bundles, as produced by `lantern diff -f json`.

old.description: Resolved path of the baseline (older) bundle.

new.description: Resolved path of the candidate (newer) bundle.

added_ids.description: Receipt IDs present in `new` but not in `old`.

removed_ids.description: Receipt IDs present in `old` but not in `new`. A non-empty list deserves auditor attention.

kept_count.description: Number of receipt IDs that appear in both bundles.

event_deltas.description: Per-event-type counts in each bundle, useful for spotting regressions like a sudden drop in gate.evaluated or rise in gate.failed.
